subject: maths
question: If sin x = 6 / 10 and x is an acute angle, find the result of the following: (1 + tan x) / (1 - tan x).
solution:
**Given:**

sin x = 6/10

x is an acute angle

Expression: (1 + tan x) / (1 - tan x)

**Formula used:**

sin²x + cos²x = 1

tan x = sin x / cos x

**Calculations:**

sin x = 6/10 = 3/5

⇒ sin²x = (3/5)² = 9/25

⇒ cos²x = 1 - sin²x = 1 - 9/25 = 16/25

⇒ cos x = √(16/25) = 4/5

⇒ tan x = sin x / cos x = (3/5) / (4/5) = 3/4

⇒ (1 + tan x) / (1 - tan x)

⇒ (1 + 3/4) / (1 - 3/4)

⇒ (4/4 + 3/4) / (4/4 - 3/4)

⇒ (7/4) / (1/4)

⇒ 7

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
